titel: Foto in de huisvorm bij “Wat u vooraf kunt regelen”, ronde 4
lead: Ronde 4, op dezelfde foto en dezelfde dozen. Beide dozen dragen nu precies dezelfde belettering: logo, naam en het nummer 085 000 5647. Het nummer blijft laag staan. Het logo is gecentreerd, en omdat dat twee kanten op kan ziet u beide: bij C staat het logo in het hart van het doosvlak, bij D in het hart van de ruimte boven het nummer. De inkt houdt per doos het licht van dat vlak, dus de achterste doos bij de deur krijgt lichter en koeler inkt dan de voorste in de schaduw. Onder het beeld staan beide lezingen naast elkaar: wat de plaat toont, en beide dozen op 3x.
extra:
STILLEVEN, GEEN MENSEN (this round only):
- There is NOBODY in this photograph. No person, no hand, no arm, no leg, no shadow of a person, no reflection of a person. The subject is the boxes and the room.
- THE SUBJECT SITS LEFT OF CENTRE AND LOW: the stack of boxes stands in the left half of the frame, roughly a third in from the left edge, with its base in the lower half. The right half of the frame is the room behind it. A square crop taken from the left of this picture has to contain the whole stack.
- THE FRONT BOX IS BLANK: the box facing the camera has one clean, flat, unbroken front panel of plain brown kraft cardboard. No print, no logo, no lettering, no stickers, no tape crossing that panel, no handwriting, no shipping label, nothing at all on it. A mark is printed on afterwards, so anything the camera sees there has to be removed again. The tape runs along the TOP of the boxes, never down the front face.
- USED BUT SOUND: these boxes have moved house before. Softened corners, a scuffed edge or two, a faint dent in a lid, slightly furred cardboard where a hand has gripped, one box a shade darker than the next. Not flat-packed-this-morning, not battered or crushed either. The room has lived in it too: a scuff on the skirting board, a slightly worn floorboard.
- DUTCH HOME: white plastered walls or soft off-white, white-painted skirting, a wooden floor or a light tiled floor, daylight from a tall window with a white frame. Calm, honest, not styled like a catalogue.
- LIGHT: soft, even daylight from the side. The front panel of the front box is evenly lit, unshadowed and free of any hard highlight, because the mark has to sit on it convincingly.
- No text anywhere in the image: no writing on the boxes, no labels, no book titles, no signs.

versies.naam: In de gang bij de voordeur
versies.scene: Four plain brown kraft moving boxes stacked in the hallway of a Dutch row house, left of centre, seen from a low angle so the stack rises through the frame and the front box is large and square to the camera. Behind them the front door stands ajar with daylight coming in, a coat hook rail on the wall, a doormat, a pair of shoes set aside. Warm, ordinary, nobody in sight.
